opticalTransfer.title: Optical Transfer
opticalTransfer.subtitle: Move your data with light
opticalTransfer.explainer: Copy everything to another phone using just the two screens. One phone shows a stream of QR codes, the other reads them with its camera. No internet, no cable, no account — but both phones need Musclog.
opticalTransfer.sendCardSubtitle: Show your data as QR codes
opticalTransfer.receiveCardSubtitle: Scan and replace this phone's data
opticalTransfer.passphraseHint: Anyone pointing a camera at the sending screen can read the transfer. A passphrase makes that useless — type the same one on both phones.
opticalTransfer.passphraseRequiredHint: Your settings require a passphrase for exports.
opticalTransfer.webNote: This works in your browser too: sending shows the codes on this screen, receiving uses this device’s camera.

send.title: Send
send.streamingSubtitle: Point the other phone's camera here
send.noProgressHere: Progress is shown on the receiving phone.
send.buildingCache: Warming up — this speeds up shortly.
send.preparingHint: Measuring this device so the stream runs as fast as it can.
send.readyEstimate: About {{seconds}} seconds, if the other phone keeps up
send.readyInstructions: Open Optical Transfer on the other phone, choose Receive, then point its camera at this screen. Keep both phones still and close together.

share.sendMealInstructions: On the other phone, open My Meals, tap +, choose Import from another phone, then point its camera at this screen.
share.noIngredients: This meal has no ingredients to send.
share.includePhotoHint: Photos take much longer to transfer. Leave this off for the fastest send.
share.savedReusedFoods_one: {{count}} ingredient matched a food already on this phone.
share.savedReusedFoods_other: {{count}} ingredients matched foods already on this phone.
share.notAMeal: This is a full backup, not a meal. Receive it from Settings → Optical Transfer instead.
share.unreadable: This meal could not be read. Try sending it again.

receive.title: Receive
receive.subtitle: Point at the other phone's screen
receive.aimHint: Fill this view with the code on the other phone.
receive.noSignalTips: Move the phones closer so the code fills this view. Prop them both against something — hand shake makes the camera hunt for focus. Turn the sending phone's brightness all the way up.
receive.noSignalLowResolution: This camera scans at a low resolution. On the sending phone, pick a lower density.
receive.passphrasePrompt: This transfer is protected with a passphrase. Enter the one used on the sending phone.
receive.replaceExplainer: This will erase everything currently in Musclog on this phone and replace it. A copy of this phone's current data is saved to Local Backups first.
receive.confirmTitle: Replace all data on this phone?
receive.confirmMessage: Everything currently in Musclog on this phone will be erased and replaced with the data you just received.
receive.confirmWarning: This cannot be undone from here. A copy of your current data is saved to Local Backups first.
receive.authPrompt: Confirm replacing all data on this phone
receive.tooNew: This data was sent by a newer version of Musclog. Update this phone first.
receive.checksumFailed: The data did not survive the transfer.
receive.failed: Something went wrong reading the transfer.
receive.nothingChanged: Nothing on this phone was changed.
receive.restoringHint: This can take a minute on a large database. Keep Musclog open.
receive.cameraPermissionMessage: Musclog needs the camera to read the codes on the other phone. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.
receive.cameraPermissionSettings: Camera access was denied. Enable it for Musclog in system settings, then come back.
receive.cameraPermissionBrowser: Your browser blocked camera access. Allow it for this site from the address bar, then try again.
receive.noCamera: No back camera is available on this device.

quality.speedHint: Slower gives the other camera longer to catch each code.
quality.sizeHint: Simpler codes scan far more easily.
quality.sizeHintWithTime: Simpler codes scan far more easily. About {{seconds}}s at this setting.
quality.sizeRestartsNote: Changing code size restarts the transfer, so try speed first.

probe.title: Trying to import optical data?
probe.message: That code is part of a Musclog transfer between phones, not a food barcode. Open the optical reader to receive the meal.
